top_signals.title: European Stocks Drop as Bond Yields Spook Investors; Banks Lag
top_signals.summary: European stocks fell as regional bond yields climbed, denting the appeal of equities and fueling concerns about the economic impact of higher borrowing costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
